create_split_and_concat_module: create a SplitAndConcat module to split a tensor along one dimension and concatenate along another
run_split_and_concat_forward: run the SplitAndConcat forward pass to chunk and concatenate a PyTorch tensor across specified dimensions
create_add_coord_channels_module: create an AddCoordChannels module to append normalized x and y coordinate channels to a tensor
run_add_coord_channels_with_r: run the AddCoordChannels forward pass with radial distance to append x, y, and r channels to a tensor
review_inplace_delegate: review the inplace_delegate function to delegate API calls to a submodule for quantization support
